City Council Agendas & Minutes
------------------------------

Agendas, Minutes, & Packet information is now available through the City of Kittitas's Agenda app. No download is required and you can access the information on your mobile or desktop device.

* [Current Council Meeting Agendas, Minutes, & Packets](https://www.towncloud.io/go/kittitas-wa/)

* [Click Here For Archived Meeting Minutes](http://www.cityofkittitas.com/minutes_archive.html)
